---
title: Veal Agnolotti

time_min: 65
difficulty: hard
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g egg pasta
## Method
1. 350 g veal round, 100 g sausage, 50 g breadcrumbs, 80 g Grana Padano, 20 g butter, nutmeg, 1 l meat broth (see basic preparations), salt. Melt the butter in a saucepan and brown the veal round for 4-5 minutes, moisten it with a little broth, cover and let it cook for 10 minutes, until tender; cook the sausage in boiling water, then drain it, grind it with the meat and collect it in a bowl with the veal cooking juices; mix in an egg, the breadcrumbs, 40 g of Grana Padano, a pinch of salt and one of nutmeg.
2. Cover the bowl with a cloth and let it rest in a cool place.
3. Roll out the egg pasta very thinly and cut it with a cookie cutter into disks of about 4 cm in diameter; place a portion of filling in the center of each, fold the pasta into a half-moon and press along the edges.
4. Bring the broth to a boil and cook the ravioli in it.
5. Serve them in deep plates, sprinkling with the remaining Grana Padano.
